title: [WT-08] Wrappers: completion landing to the target, local path
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §2.2 (L4 without a remote, L5, L5b, L7, L8, L10, L11, L12), §2.3 (the no-gate retry bound), §2.7 and §2.9.

Objective: a worktree-mode worker exiting at REVIEW lands the task's net change on the target (main) as one commit made by a merge-tree squash and a compare-and-swap. Non-overlapping hunks from different tasks in one file merge automatically, and a true conflict lands nothing.

Deliverable, in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 as twins (the worktree arm of run_landing / Invoke-MoeLanding):
- The task-branch commit (reusing WT-07's L2).
- Target resolution, and MOE_LAND_TARGET_CHECKED_OUT when the target is checked out in any worktree.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree -z --name-only B T` (exit 1 is a conflict: land nothing; record failed with MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_CONFLICT for now, and WT-11 adds the route).
- The .moe board guard MOE_WORKTREE_BOARD_PATH.
- C = commit-tree M -p B, with the existing hooked-commit helper when commitHooks is set.
- The receipt journal before publishing.
- The local CAS `update-ref refs/heads/<target> C B`; a target that already contains C counts as success; at most 3 L4-L10 attempts, then MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION.
- The L11 sync commit T' = commit-tree tree(C) -p T -p C and `git -C W merge --ff-only T'` with hooks off (failure: MOE_WORKTREE_SYNC_FAILED, retried at the next pre-flight).
- record_commit completion (ref refs/heads/<target>, paths = diff B..C), then finalize_attempt landed.
- Idempotent re-landing (M equals B's tree: nothing).
- peel_target_branch and ensure_safe_branch are NOT called in worktree mode.

The WT-08T files (task-c12f9463b68c44a18cc460a7e9460247) are held out: their `local` cases must pass with NO edit to scripts/tests/worktree-landing.{sh,ps1}. Depends on WT-07 (task-b319b263fada419d9d7de279682dc5f4).

NOT in scope:
- fetch and push to a remote (WT-09)
- the gate and lease (WT-10)
- finalize 'unlanded' and conflict resume (WT-11)
- board snapshot (WT-12)
- control follow (WT-13)
- shared-mode landing, which stays unchanged
- docs (WT-18)

Verification: bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh --only local && node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh (and on a Windows seat: powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/worktree-landing.ps1 --only local)
definitionOfDone: bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh --only local exits 0, and `git diff --quiet <WT-08T landed sha> -- scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh scripts/tests/worktree-landing.ps1` shows the held-out files unchanged.
The ps1 twin's local cases pass on a Windows seat (powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/worktree-landing.ps1 --only local).
In worktree mode neither peel_target_branch nor ensure_safe_branch (Ensure-MoeSafeBranch) runs; a grep of the worktree arm shows main is moved only by `update-ref refs/heads/<target> <new> <old>`.
node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash passes with all existing shared-mode cases unchanged.
Both wrappers carry the same MOE_WORKTREE_/MOE_LAND_/MOE_CONTROL_/MOE_BOARD_ codes (grep -oE diff is empty); bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh exits 0.

comments.author: worker-0062feec
comments.content:
Contract correction from the WT-S revision after QA reject 1. Where this comment and the row's description differ, the revised docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md and this comment win. Plan against revised §2.2:
1. The step names changed. L9 is now "Publish". In local mode that is `update-ref refs/heads/<target> C B`. After a lost CAS, a target that contains C is success, and anything else ends the round. A landing gets at most 3 rounds of L4-L9. L10 is now the remote-mode mirror and belongs to WT-09.
2. L7, when commitHooks is true:
   - moe_commit_with_hooks / New-MoeHookedCommit run the hooks with GIT_WORK_TREE set to a disposable detached worktree that materializes M under '/*' '!/.moe/'. They never use the shared checkout for this.
   - The temp index marks `.moe/` skip-worktree.
   - Keep their existing refusal when a hook changed the tree or the parent.
   - Add a case: a hook edits a file → `failed` with rescue, and nothing is published.
3. L12 sends `pushed: false` in local mode.
4. §2.9: when M equals B's tree, L12 records whatever receipt_landed_as finds for the journaled C, and otherwise `nothing`.
WT-08T's `local` cases must still pass unchanged.

comments.author: worker-0062feec
comments.content:
Follow-up to the WT-S revision comment above. Put the L7 hook cases in scripts/tests/postflight.{sh,ps1}, because the WT-08T files stay held out:
- A hook that edits a file gives `failed` with rescue, and nothing is published.
- The hook's work tree holds M and has no `.moe/`.
This row's files become 4: the two wrappers plus both postflight harnesses.
